config.label: Lawmatics OAuth access token (never expires)
config.description: Lawmatics OAuth access token (never expires). Obtain once with `npx @oktopeak/lawmatics-mcp auth`.

config.label: Set to '1' to disable all write tools (create/update/tag/submit)
config.description: Set to '1' to disable all write tools (create/update/tag/submit). Read-only mode for cautious firms.

config.label: Set to '1' to enable experimental tools (set-matter-custom-fields) whose API request shape is not fully documented by Lawmatics
config.description: Set to '1' to enable experimental tools (set-matter-custom-fields) whose API request shape is not fully documented by Lawmatics.

config.label: Client-side request throttle per minute (default: 50, the conservative documented per-firm limit; newer docs say 150)
config.description: Client-side request throttle per minute (default: 50, the conservative documented per-firm limit; newer docs say 150).

config.label: Set to '0' to disable the local JSONL audit log (default path: ~/
config.description: Set to '0' to disable the local JSONL audit log (default path: ~/.lawmatics-mcp/audit.log).

config.label: Override the audit log file location (default: ~/
config.description: Override the audit log file location (default: ~/.lawmatics-mcp/audit.log). The log contains tool arguments, which can include client data.

config.label: Only needed for the one-time `auth` command: your Lawmatics developer app client ID
config.description: Only needed for the one-time `auth` command: your Lawmatics developer app client ID.

config.label: Only needed for the one-time `auth` command: your Lawmatics developer app client secret
config.description: Only needed for the one-time `auth` command: your Lawmatics developer app client secret.

config.label: Local port for the one-time OAuth callback (default: 5678)
config.description: Local port for the one-time OAuth callback (default: 5678). Must match the app's Callback URL.

config.label: Override the Lawmatics API base URL (default: https://api
config.description: Override the Lawmatics API base URL (default: https://api.lawmatics.com/v1).
